$comment: Source is TypeScript now (src/host/*.ts, src/client/*.ts), and every .ts file is type-checked unconditionally — `checkJs` only governs plain .js files, of which src/ has none. strict/noImplicitAny stay false (for now), so untyped parameters are implicit-any and pass: the ONE shape that does not is a parameter WITH a default initializer, which is typed from that initializer — give it an explicit annotation instead of JSDoc (@param/@type are comments in a .ts file). noEmit:true means this check never produces artifacts — the build is tsdown's job. Run it with `npm run typecheck`.
